一根线，每一拍上面有一位。先听它，再自己往上说。: One line, one bit on it each tick. Listen to it first, then talk on it yourself.
线上每一拍有一位：怎样听它，怎样说？: A bit on the line each tick: how to hear it, how to speak?
世界前进的一步：每一拍，线上有一位，板上的电路算一遍。: One step of the world: each tick the line carries one bit and the board computes once.
线上每一拍有一位：0 或 1。: The line carries one bit each tick: 0 or 1.
每一拍交出线上的位。: Give the bit on the line, every tick.
板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下。要留下一个值到下一拍，用一对新元件: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
寄存卡让电路记得上一拍。: A register lets a circuit remember the tick before.
每一拍把输入上一拍的值说到线上；第一拍说 0。: Every tick, say on the line what the input was the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.
